mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benefit_product ( code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, valid_days INT NOT NULL, status TINYINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (code) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benefit_product_item ( product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, item_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (product_code, item_code) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benefit_card ( id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, source_channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, source_ref VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status TINYINT NOT NULL, valid_from DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, valid_to DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_benefit_card_source (source_channel, source_ref), KEY idx_benefit_card_account (account_id, valid_to) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benefit_balance ( card_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, item_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, remaining DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (card_id, item_code) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benefit_hold ( order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, card_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, item_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, hold_count INT NOT NULL, hold_amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, cash_due DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, catalog_amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, status TINYINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM benefit_product WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_product (code, name, valid_days, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{validDays}, 1) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = incoming.name, valid_days = incoming.valid_days, status = 1
INSERT INTO benefit_product_item (product_code, item_code, quantity) VALUES (#{code}, #{itemCode}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, valid_days AS validDays FROM benefit_product WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 1
SELECT item_code AS itemCode, quantity FROM benefit_product_item WHERE product_code = #{code} ORDER BY item_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_card (id, account_id, product_code, source_channel, source_ref, status, valid_from, valid_to) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{productCode}, #{channel}, #{sourceRef}, 1, #{validFrom}, #{validTo})
INSERT INTO benefit_balance (card_id, item_code, remaining) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{itemCode}, #{remaining})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, account_id, card_id, item_code, hold_count, hold_amount, cash_due, catalog_amount, status FROM benefit_hold WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_hold (order_id, account_id, card_id, item_code, hold_count, hold_amount, cash_due, catalog_amount, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{accountId}, #{cardId}, #{itemCode}, #{holdCount}, #{holdAmount}, #{cashDue}, #{catalogAmount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit_hold SET status = #{status} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cardId, c.valid_to AS validTo, b.item_code AS itemCode, b.remaining FROM benefit_card c JOIN benefit_balance b ON b.card_id = c.id WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.valid_to > #{now} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS cardId, c.product_code AS productCode, b.item_code AS itemCode, b.remaining, c.valid_to AS validTo FROM benefit_card c JOIN benefit_balance b ON b.card_id = c.id WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.valid_to > #{now} ORDER BY c.valid_to, c.id, b.item_code
